ambient: The room is amused, on the beat.
You get it again, and it was already common knowledge again.
description: The enormous thing you have just understood turns out to be common knowledge, and always was, and the room is faintly amused that you have only got here now. Nobody is unkind about it. This is simply the ordinary state of things and you had not been paying attention.
name: Everyone Already Knew

looks: Obvious. Structural. Written on the inside of everything.
You had it as a child and put it down somewhere.
Everyone has it. That is what makes it funny.
objects.name: the common knowledge

looks: Fond rather than unkind, which does not make it better.
It is coming from the room, or from the beat, or from you.
It arrives on the beat, like everything else here.
objects.name: the amusement
